description:
Full Stack Software Engineer 

 Location: Austin, TX (Hybrid, 3 days/week onsite) 

 Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for the duration of employment without requiring current or future employer sponsorship of any kind, including but not limited to OPT, STEM OPT, H-1B, or any other visa classification. 

 About Us 

 TogetherWork is a $250M recurring revenue SaaS business with over 33 software applications serving 12+ vertical markets. We exist to help communities, organizations, and businesses thrive by delivering software solutions tailored to their unique needs.

 With our new headquarters on South Congress in Austin, TX, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. We work hard and play hard. We love our customers, we innovate with purpose, and we won't stop until we've delighted every client across the diverse ecosystem we serve.

 About This Role

 TogetherWork is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and support of software solutions across our SaaS platforms.

 Working alongside experienced engineers, product teams, and technical leaders, you'll build foundational engineering skills while contributing to customer-facing products and internal systems. You will be mentored by senior engineers and gain hands-on exposure to full-stack development, cloud technologies, DevOps practices, AI-assisted development, and modern software engineering methodologies.

 This role is best suited to an engineer who is passionate about software development, enjoys solving problems, has a strong desire to learn modern technologies, and demonstrates ownership, curiosity, and a growth mindset.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Develop, test, debug, document, and support software features across our SaaS platforms

 Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and testable code following established engineering standards

 Collaborate with engineers, Product Managers, QA, and business stakeholders to deliver customer value

 Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to continuously improve code quality and engineering skills

 Troubleshoot issues in development, test, and production environments with guidance from senior engineers

 Assist in developing APIs, integrations, user interfaces, and backend services

 Learn and adopt cloud-native development practices and modern engineering tools

 Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge-sharing initiatives

 Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement

 Utilize AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, code quality, troubleshooting, testing, and learning

 Leverage AI responsibly for research, implementation support, documentation, and automation assistance — reviewing and validating AI-generated output before it reaches production

 Demonstrate ownership, accountability, professionalism, and a continuous learning mindset

 
 What You'll Bring 

 
 1-3 years of professional software development experience, internship experience, or equivalent practical experience

 Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design principles

 Exposure to one or more modern languages/frameworks — PHP (Laravel, Symfony), Python (Django, Flask, FastAPI), or JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Node.js, Vue.js, Angular) — through coursework, internships, personal projects, open-source contributions, or professional work

 Foundational knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript, with exposure to modern front-end frameworks, responsive design, and accessibility principles

 Basic understanding of RESTful APIs, service integrations, and authentication/authorization fundamentals

 Basic understanding of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), SQL fundamentals, and data modeling concepts

 Exposure to AWS, Git and modern source-control workflows, CI/CD concepts, and Docker/containerized applications

 Understanding of secure coding fundamentals, automated testing, and software quality practices

 Proven, daily experience using AI tooling for AI-native development, applied responsibly

 Good understanding of Agile/Scrum development methodologies

 Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 Self-starter with strong communication skills, a demonstrated ability to learn new technologies quickly, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement

 
 Why This Role 

 
 Impact: Contribute to customer-facing products and internal systems across a portfolio of 33+ software applications serving 12+ vertical markets.

 Challenge: Build foundational engineering skills across full-stack development, cloud technologies, DevOps, and AI-assisted development, with direct mentorship from senior engineers.

 Ownership: Take accountability for your assigned work while gaining increasing independence in development, troubleshooting, and solution delivery.

 Collaboration: Partner with engineers, Product Managers, QA, and business stakeholders in an Agile environment built on obsessing over our customers, owning it together, and moving fast with purpose.

 
 Benefits Overview 

 The Company offers a comprehensive employee benefits program, including:

 
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

 Healthcare navigation and wellness benefits

 Employer-paid life and disability coverage

 Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

 401(k) retirement plan with company matching

 Generous paid time off and company holidays

 Paid parental and caregiver leave programs

 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

 Pet insurance and additional voluntary benefits

 
 Inclusion and Diversity 

 TogetherWork is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We are a company where diverse backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints are valued. TogetherWork does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, age, ethnic or national origin, or any other basis protected by all local, state or federal laws.

 Interview Process & Expectations 

 Our interviews are designed to assess a candidate's own experience, technical reasoning, problem-solving approach, and communication skills. Candidates are expected to respond based on their own knowledge and experience during live interviews. To ensure a fair and consistent interview experience, the use of real-time AI tools or other external assistance to generate or guide interview responses is not permitted.
